info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Relationship Management Update API
info.description: The Customer Relationship Management Update API enables businesses to modify existing customer relationship data efficiently. This endpoint allows for updates to key customer information, enhancing data accuracy and compliance with business needs. Typical consumers of this API include customer service teams and data management systems that require real-time updates to customer profiles. By leveraging this functionality, organizations can foster better customer interactions and streamline their relationship management processes.

patch.description: This operation allows users to modify the details of a specific customer relationship identified by CUST-100045. It provides the functionality to update fields relevant to customer relationship management, ensuring that all interactions are captured and recorded appropriately for better data integrity and customer service.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the properties of the customer with ID CUST-100045 within the customer relationship management system. Ensure that all required fields are included, and any fields you wish to update should be properly formatted according to the specified schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully, and the resource has been updated.
